questions.question: What will be the output of the following pseudocode?
questions.code:
Integer solve(Integer a, Integer b)
    Set a = a * 2 + b
    Set b = b * 2 + a
    return b - a
End function solve

Integer ans
Set ans = solve(4, 5)
Print ans
questions.explanation: Inside solve(4, 5): a becomes 4*2 + 5 = 13. b becomes 5*2 + 13 = 23. return b - a = 10.

questions.question: What will be the output of the following pseudocode?
questions.code:
Integer compute(Integer x)
    return x * 3 - 4
End function compute

Integer p, q
Set p = 6
Set q = compute(p)
Print p + q
questions.explanation: compute(6) returns 6*3 - 4 = 14. In the main scope, p remains 6 (pass by value). p + q = 6 + 14 = 20.

questions.question: What will be the output of the following pseudocode?
questions.code:
Integer helper(Integer n, Integer m)
    Integer res, i
    Set res = 0
    for(i = 1 to n)
        Set res = res + (i mod m)
    End for
    return res
End function helper

Integer out
Set out = helper(3, 7)
Print out
questions.explanation: helper(3, 7) computes sum of (i mod 7) for i from 1 to 3. Sum = 6.

questions.question: What will be the output of the following pseudocode?
questions.code:
Integer g(Integer k)
    return (k * 2) - 3
End function g

Integer res
Set res = g(g(5))
Print res
questions.explanation: Inner call g(5) = (5 * 2) - 3 = 7. Outer call g(7) = (7 * 2) - 3 = 11.

questions.question: What will be the output of the following pseudocode?
questions.code:
Integer check(Integer u, Integer v)
    if(u > v)
        return (u - v) * 2
    else
        return (v - u) * 3
    End if
End function check

Integer ans
Set ans = check(8, 4)
Print ans
questions.explanation: For u=8, v=4: u > v is True. Evaluating the active branch yields 8.
